name: Husqvarna T540 XP Mark III
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on .325″ Mini Pixel chain, .043″ gauge: 51, 59 and 64 drive links, with a 5/32″ file — per Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The T540 XP Mark III is Husqvarna's top-handle arborist saw, and it runs a chain most owners have never bought before: .325″ pitch in the narrow .043″ gauge (Husqvarna's SP21G X-Cut, sold as .325″ Mini Pixel). That gauge is the trap. The .325″ chain on Husqvarna's 435, 445S and 450 Rancher is .050″, and a .050″ loop will not sit in the narrow groove of the X-Precision bar this saw is fitted with, so match the gauge as well as the drive-link count. The guide pairs this chain with a 5/32″ file, not the 3/16″ file it lists for regular .325″ chain such as the 435's SP33G. The same fit-up guide also has a separate “T540 XP” entry with the identical 14″ and 16″ bar and chain part numbers but no 12″ row.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide lists bar X-Precision 596553651 with chain SP21G X-Cut 596553351 (51 drive links) for the 12″ setup.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide lists bar X-Precision 596553659 with chain SP21G X-Cut 596553359 (59 drive links) for the 14″ setup.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide lists bar X-Precision 596553664 with chain SP21G X-Cut 596553364 (64 drive links) for the 16″ setup.
